text:
Alex: quick flag — ran the q6a-int8 bring-up on the long-summarization cohort and hit clusters with large divergence vs fp16. seems tied to near-duplicate prompts with tiny scaffolding changes. @Priya @Omar can you eyeball?

Priya: sure. can you paste a pair of examples so we can see if it's paraphrase or prefix differences?

Alex: examples: 
```
P1: "Summarize the following 90-minute product review and list action items."
P2: "Produce a concise action-item summary for this 90m product review transcript."
P3: "Create bullet action items from the product review meeting notes (very long)."
```
All same intent, different scaffolding. our tokenization/truncation after quantized vocab packing made the hashes diverge.

Omar: yep — seen this before. plan: 1) normalized template strip (remove boilerplate prefixes), 2) semantic embeddings (mini-SBERT), 3) cluster @0.87 sim, 4) soft-dedupe where clusters exceed size thresholds. agree on threshold?

Priya: 0.87 sounds good to start. I'll run the pipeline and produce a LabelOps CSV with: cluster_id, top3_exemplars, token_len_fp16, token_len_q6a, avg_rougeL_delta, suggested_action. will stage at s3://redwood-curation/q6a_dedupe_triage.csv

Jin: please include fp16 vs q6a output snippets for the top exemplar (first 2 paragraphs) so labelers can inspect quality vs style shifts.

Alex: also spin a micro-eval: 250 holdout prompts through fp16 + q6a-int8, compute ROUGE-L and an entity-preservation check. queue a qbench run and attach link.

eval-bot: qbench run queued by Alex 1 id qb-4020. preliminary results available after run completes.

Priya: quick cost ETA: embedding pass for current promptbank (~1.2M) ~1.8 v100-days. sharded (12) should finish embeddings in ~6h, clustering ~2h.

LabelOps: tagging you for ~350 review decisions if clusters look noisy. we'll sample high-risk clusters first (>=5 prompts with >=5pt ROUGE-L drop).

Omar: started dedupe job dedupe-4020 shard 0/12. logs: dedupe-4020 | shard 0/12 | working. ETA ~6h.

Jin: I'll attach diff snippets and NE-preservation stats to the CSV export.

eval-bot: qb-4020 started. preliminary mean ROUGE-L drop -2.1; ~10% of prompts show >=5pt drop. full CSV link will be posted to the thread.

Alex: OK. next steps: Priya runs dedupe and posts CSV, LabelOps reviews sampled clusters, we expand golden by +2 exemplars for flagged clusters, then run a micro-golden re-eval and decide canary. blockers: LabelOps bandwidth and a small compute bump for canary.

Priya: will upload CSV to s3 path above and post link here when ready.

Omar: will follow up with final cluster counts and v100-hours used once run completes.

Alex: thanks team 1 please ping here when CSV + qbench link are available.
